post.summary: Run executes an agent to completion and returns the final output.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: The agent identifier to run. Required.

get.summary:
Subscribe streams incremental progress events for a running agent. The
server pushes SubscribeResponse until the agent finishes or the client
disconnects.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: The agent identifier to subscribe to. Required.

input.description: Free-form input passed to the agent as the user message.

AgentServiceRunBody.description: RunRequest is the input to AgentService.Run.

id.description: Stable identifier. For humans, the user id; for services, the service name.

created_at.description: When this actor was first seen.

v1Actor.description:
Actor identifies something (user, service account, system component) that
initiated or is responsible for a request.

page_size.description: Maximum number of items to return. Zero means "use server default".

page_token.description:
Opaque continuation token from a previous PageInfo.next_page_token. Empty
means "first page".

v1Pagination.description: Pagination is the canonical request envelope for list RPCs.

output.description: Final output produced by the agent.

session_id.description: Server-assigned session id for follow-up calls.

actor.description: The actor that initiated the run.

v1RunResponse.description: RunResponse is the output of AgentService.Run.

agent_id.description: The agent identifier this event belongs to.

delta.description:
Incremental text delta since the previous event. Empty means
"metadata-only event".

sequence.description:
Monotonically increasing per-stream sequence number. Clients use this to
reorder events after reconnect.

v1SubscribeResponse.description: SubscribeResponse is one delta pushed by AgentService.Subscribe.
